ok 62 - a font that resvg cannot read keeps Pele's widths, so the chart keeps every label # SKIP cannot find a Type 1 font

ok 63 - a bold or italic face that resvg cannot read is measured in its regular face, so the chart keeps every label # SKIP needs Nimbus Sans with an OpenType regular face and Type 1 bold and italic faces

ok 124 - a run whose rename fails after it moves the output folder aside puts the folder back, or says where it is # SKIP requires Linux LD_PRELOAD and a compilable rename injector
